description: UE5-specific workflow activation rules for the Gloamstead agent_collab substrate. Small tasks must not pull the full roster. See docs/agents/UE5-Agent-Substrate-Review.md section 6 for the full matrix and rationale.

default_activation.description: Small tasks default to minimal roster. Planner only when justified by size, ownership risk, or human gates.
default_activation.requires_planner: task_count > 1 OR ownership_prediction_risk = high OR docs_impact = true OR requires_human_playtest = true OR task_type in ['feature-implementation', 'refactor', 'migration', 'large-multi-file', 'schema-change']

small_bug_fix.notes: Pure text change in owned Source/ or Config/. No generated content.

feature_implementation.notes: Always route through Planner for ownership in C++/BP/PCG/Data mixes.

refactor.notes: Planner ownership prediction is primary collision defense under LFS.

dependency_or_asset_change.notes: Plugins, engine association, Marketplace/Fab packs, licenses = human only.

migration_schema_change.notes: Data contracts for rituals, night consequences, restoration, saves are high-risk.

documentation_only.notes: After the triggering code change is green. Use documentation-update playbook, not a dedicated documentor role.

large_vertical_slice_wave.notes: Full path: candidate branch + Critic APPROVED + recorded playtest before work branch promotion. Never skip for generated content.

enforcement: Orchestrator prompts, /gloam-start-task, and Build-WavePlan must consult this file. Planner is not a default tax on every task.
